title: Qualify Development Engine V1 at exact head
objective: Execute the Development Engine V1 candidate validator and adversarial suite at one exact engineering HEAD, bind the candidate to exact Git tree/blob identities through the existing ENG-06 exact-head machinery, and emit machine-readable T4 qualification material without promoting business development or runtime execution.
non_goals: change Development Engine V1 candidate material assembled by WU01
weaken or replace ENG-06 certification semantics
activate trading runtime leverage or withdrawals
introduce a paid service or mandatory LLM review

forbidden_semantics: Lot45 candidate mutation remediation or merge

required_invariants: WU01 candidate and policy remain byte-identical inputs throughout this work unit
qualification driver imports and reuses ENG-06 exact-head and deep-assurance controls rather than implementing parallel certification semantics
qualification candidate head equals the checked-out Git HEAD
exact-head input binding covers WU01 policy candidate validator selftest and all eight evidence inputs
qualification workflow uses exact action pins least privilege full Git history and no paid dependency
qualification output binds Git tree exact blob identities candidate id current head WU02 scope base and exact workflow run id
T3 deep assurance is evaluated through existing policy and remains NOT_REQUIRED when no T3 requirement is selected
EXACT_HEAD_CERTIFICATION is selected as the T4 requirement and cannot be reused across heads
successful qualification does not mark business unlocked does not mark Lot45 merge-ready and does not change runtime authority
acceptance_criteria: WU01 validator passes at the exact qualification HEAD
WU01 adversarial suite reports 16 probes PASS
ENG-06 exact-head self-check passes at the exact qualification HEAD
exact-head binding contains the candidate policy validator selftest and eight evidence blobs
qualification output records the current workflow run id and exact candidate head with success conclusion semantics
Security Secrets and Engineering Bootstrap pass on the same qualification HEAD
candidate remains pre-promotion and BOOT-FINDING-001 remains an explicit business-unlock blocker

done_when: one exact qualification HEAD has green Engineering Bootstrap Security Secrets and Development Engine V1 qualification workflow
qualification output is bound to the exact HEAD tree blobs and workflow run id
candidate remains pre-business-unlock and external protection blocker remains visible
no business candidate runtime or historical evidence was mutated
